Final reflection at the authoritative12-hour budget expiry: the full deployment goal was not achieved. My criteria2 final gate r0149 gave0/320 success and0hardware violations; every episode failed retention. These are my own simulation results, not an official score. The frozen placement centre was46.3mm distal to the principal midpalm-cover centre and no final start touched the palm, a material deployment-faithfulness limitation. Two alternative middle-palm interpretations also failed all128 diagnostics, with2hardware-violation episodes in closed-hand cases. They do not relabel the original gate or prove hardware/task impossibility.

What worked: reconstructionv5 passed the required contract after the full60-minute stage, with hidden layer articulation explicitly unresolved. Physical teachers established isolated prepared motions. Current library: narrow+X57/64 and U-clockwise54/64; front nominal64/64 was historical, latest legal-state front19/64 is not mastered. The paired temporal-prior/PPO counts52/57,+X;57/54,top;64/64,frontnominal;19/19,frontlegal show only limited positive+X evidence, no general PPO advantage.

What failed: acquisition, actual transitions, reverse signs and other axes. Acquisition was not registered as a separate prerequisite, so whole-task training began with inadequate capture/transition proof. WholePPO011/013 changed parameters over3.28million actions yet deployment success stayed zero. Guard, force-allocation, wrist-unloading, projected-cup and finger-gait teachers did not solve capture. Prepared skills were strongly sensitive to physical priors. GPU physics parity failed and was excluded; GPUs only optimized networks. The passive cube guide is unmeasured, with no fracture model or real transfer evidence. A late montage inspection(r0141), omitted pad torsion in an audit(correctedr0161/62), and the distal-placement interpretation are disclosed.

Next I would measure faithful operator placement into a sensible hand pose, prove a robust cap…
